Elena (Finance): Received invoice from PortoAnalytics PT. They billed us net with 'reverse charge' and included PT VAT ID, but AP asked if we should gross-up because vendor expects US payment and says US withholding applies. Any quick guidance?

invoice-bot: New invoice #PA-3321 1803005544 05/07/26 EUR 3,420 vendor VAT: PT500123456

Marco (Vendor Ops): Common mismatch. Need to confirm which Redwood entity is on the invoice and which entity will remit payment. If invoice is to Redwood EU entity, reverse charge should cover VAT.

Tara (Tax): Short answer: gross-up = withholding concern, separate from VAT. If we pay from Redwood Inc (US) and vendor is not US tax resident, they could be subject to US withholding unless they provide appropriate W-8 documentation. If invoice is to Redwood Portugal or Redwood B.V. and paid from EU, reverse charge is appropriate and no VAT to us. We do NOT gross-up automatically.

Iris (Accounting): Invoice snapshot:
```
Invoice: PA-3321
Date: 2026-05-06
Billed to: Redwood Portugal Lda? (field unclear)
Amount: EUR 3,420
VAT: 0% reverse charge (vendor VAT PT500123456)
```

Elena (Finance): I'll ask vendor to: 1) confirm billed legal entity (exact name and VAT), 2) provide VAT registration extract, 3) state where services were performed, and 4) if they expect payment from Redwood Inc, supply W-8BEN-E and a written gross-up calc plus contract clause if they demand net payment. Payment on hold until docs.

Marco (Vendor Ops): Sending that now and pausing AP. Add a note: "we will not accept verbal gross-up requests; documentation and contract basis required."

invoice-bot: Payment hold placed: missing tax documentation 1803005575

Tara (Tax): If they push back on gross-up, escalate to Legal. Also confirm country of tax residence on any provided certificate.

Elena (Finance): Thanks all. Will follow up when they reply. :white_check_mark:
